# FLX-3663: a response family's segments are malformed

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

segments maps a level of the estimate's groupBy column, written as a non-empty text, to the id of a Segment. A family names at least 1 and at most 1,024 segments.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3663
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
